assets.prompt: Redrawn at 2x detail (two art pixels a world pixel, drawn at half size in the game) from its 1x art with the same layout, frames and silhouette: its diagonals smoothed to one-pixel steps and its outside outline one art pixel thick, then given new detail at the finer pixels: each material's surface on every shade of a part's inside (bone pitted with pores, light flecks in the fire, wood grain in broken streaks along each part's length, glints on the gold, a light speckle on the blight and the stone, the same in every frame of a strip; a body's Stone shadow made its base) and a one-pixel lit edge on each part's top-left and a shaded one on its bottom-right (Stone kept at its base there); palette colours only. The 1x art's prompt: The training dummy as a staff staked in the floor: a Wood staff driven into a Stone mound, with a straw-gold crossbar and a Bone target with a Fire bullseye and a Spark centre on the shaft. A 32x32 sprite, 1px dark outline, light from the top-left. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
